notes: Every full cloud archive was verified against its external SHA256 and every manifest entry before packaging.
Binaries and perf data are omitted from this compact bundle; exact hashes, frozen source, locks, run scripts, raw latency samples and gates are included.
Both score-collection builds include strict position admission and bounded shared proof caching. The only production difference is bounded score collection; no persisted format changes.
CPU software sampling and smaps_rollup are diagnostic, separate from uninstrumented latency measurements.
All engine latency comparisons use identical complete query workloads, compiler/CPU flags and immutable indexes on the same host.
ARM results cover the same first 100,000 documents with canonical and normally merged position streams; they are not the full 5,032,104-document corpus.
